## Overview

This [[adyen]] page, modified and captured 2026-09-15, is a short **Android PayPal integration chooser**. It links to Android Drop-in and Redirect Component child guides, and to their main Android integration guides. See [[adyen-online-payments]]. It does not itself specify version requirements, merchant eligibility, client/server request fields, redirect returns, tokenization or payment outcomes. See raw lines 15–33.

## Key takeaways

- **Drop-in** is labeled an all-in-one UI route for adding PayPal to an Android app. **Components** is labeled a Redirect Component route. Those labels identify which child guide to open; the child guides own actual setup and runtime behavior. See raw lines 19–31.
- The closing sentence links the main Android Drop-in and Components integration guides, both as Sessions-flow URLs in this snapshot. It does not say that those links exhaust every supported flow or version. See raw line 33.
- The page contains navigation only. It provides no direct evidence of account setup, country/currency or PayPal funding eligibility, approved authorization, capture or settlement. See raw lines 15–33.
